51 dangerous or administrative declaration entries show SQL EXECUTE denied to anon and authenticated. Examples include pg_read_file/binary_file, pg_ls_dir, replication origin, pg_stat_reset and WAL replay pause/resume; this is SQL grant evidence only.

pg_logical_emit_message/get_changes, pg_replication_slot_advance, pg_terminate_backend, pg_sleep, pg_stat_get_activity and query_to_xml show some SQL EXECUTE grants; additional PostgreSQL-native privilege protections and PostgREST exposed schemas/reachability have NOT been tested. No exploit inference or production invocation.

Read-only metadata check: both client roles NOLOGIN, non-superuser, non-replication, non-BYPASSRLS; 0 current replication slots, 1 publication, 0 observed lock-waiting sessions. Snapshot-only; no proof of future state.
